interpretation: footprint Dirty includes compressed/swapped memory, whose column is a subset. vmmap Dirty excludes its separate Swapped column. These two tools expose different views and should not be added together or added to native logical allocations. No unpublished physical-page attribution to individual buffers.
tools_preflight: Both tools successfully inspected only the current user-owned launchd Cantor PID55076 before diagnostic setup. No memory contents or all-process collection.
